nodes.label: PySpin NumPy 2.x Incompatibility Notice
nodes.rationale: Vendor confirmation that PySpin does not support NumPy 2.x — the upstream source the acquisition requirements.txt upper bound cites.

nodes.label: PySpin vs C++ API Differences
nodes.rationale: INode/IValue returned from GetNode() must be cast to their pointer types (CFloatPtr, CEnumerationPtr) before use; GetNDArray() returns a 2- or 3-D NumPy array only for select formats; node callbacks take a callback class rather than a function pointer.

nodes.label: Manual Release of CameraPtr / CameraList / SystemPtr
nodes.rationale: CameraPtr, CameraList, InterfacePtr, InterfaceList and SystemPtr must be manually released and/or deleted before program exit using the del operator — the SDK does not clean them up on scope exit the way the C++ objects do.

nodes.label: spinnaker-python Wheel Name
nodes.rationale: The pip distribution name is `spinnaker-python` even though the import name is `PySpin`, so querying pip for `pyspin` is a false negative.
